fit.description: Indicate how the image should be resized to fit its container, same as object-fit
fit.description_zh: 确定图片如何适应容器框，同原生 object-fit

scroll-container.description: The container to add scroll listener when using lazy load
scroll-container.description_zh: 开启懒加载后，监听 scroll 事件的容器

:initial-index.description: Initial preview image index, less than the length of url-list
:initial-index.description_zh: 图片预览初始图片索引

hide-on-click-modal.description: When enabling preview, use this flag to control whether clicking on backdrop can exit preview mode
hide-on-click-modal.description_zh: 在启用预览功能时点击遮罩层是否可以退出预览模式

loading.description: Indicates how the browser should load the image, same as native
loading.description_zh: 指示浏览器应如何加载图像，同原生

close-on-press-escape.description: Whether the image-viewer can be closed by pressing ESC
close-on-press-escape.description_zh: 是否可以通过按下 ESC 关闭图像查看器

preview-teleported.description: Whether to append image-viewer to body. A nested parent element attribute transform should have this attribute set to true
preview-teleported.description_zh: 是否将图像查看器添加到 body。嵌套的父元素属性 transform 应该将此属性设置为 true

infinite.description: Whether the viewer preview is infinite

:zoom-rate.description: The zoom rate of the image viewer zoom event
:zoom-rate.description_zh: 图像查看器缩放事件的缩放比率

:min-scale.description: The min scale of the image viewer zoom event
:min-scale.description_zh: 图像查看器缩放事件的最小缩放比例

:max-scale.description: The max scale of the image viewer zoom event
:max-scale.description_zh: 图像查看器缩放事件的最大缩放比例

events.name: close
events.description: Trigger when clicking on close button or when hide-on-click-modal enabled clicking on backdrop

slots.name: placeholder
slots.description: Custom placeholder content when image hasn't loaded yet
slots.description_zh: 图片未加载的占位内容

slots.name: viewer
slots.description_zh: 图片预览的自定义内容

slots.name: progress
slots.description: Custom progress content when image preview
slots.description_zh: 预览图片时的自定义进度内容

slots.name: toolbar
slots.description: Custom toolbar content when image preview
slots.description_zh: 预览图片时的自定义工具栏内容
slots.params: {actions: (action: ImageViewerAction, options?: ImageViewerActionOptions ) => void, prev: ()=> void, next: () => void, reset: () => void, activeIndex: number }
